environment: Windows Docker Desktop 27.2.0; local test port 18081; remote root SSH read-only
command: docker build -f docker/admin.Dockerfile -t chumen-web:domain-check .; docker run local isolated web; nginx -t; fetch / /admin /admin/ /admin/login; SSH docker ps and Nginx config read; remote curl /v1/health; YAML parse; CI tests; Harness validation; Secret scan
summary: Web image built successfully. Local nginx -t passed; homepage and admin deep link returned 200; /admin returned 301 with relative Location /admin/ after fixing absolute_redirect. Isolated container has no API upstream: /v1/health returned expected 502 and is NOT an API integration pass. Existing remote API /v1/health returned 200. Remote web still runs chumen-web:33de0ec on 8080 with original Nginx; ports 80/443 not listening; no /etc/letsencrypt/live certificate found. SSH root access confirmed using existing key without reading its contents. Remote writes, TLS activation and mini-program platform validation remain not-run. Seven CI tests, workflow YAML parse, Harness and Secret scan passed. Earlier Docker daemon failure resolved by starting Docker Desktop.
